description: Purple carrots are a carrot cultivar that have purple skin and orange to purple flesh. They are a little less sweet than orange carrots and sometimes have a lower yield. They can be cooked the same way as carrots.
sowing_method: Direct seed outdoors, thin to 3cm apart when seedlings are 7cm high

companions.notes: openfarm-crops-rescue lists this as a companion without indicating polarity; assumed 'good' per common convention
